column1: # Anthony Morris's copy of the State Department code (catalogue 650): his sixteen blocks of 100 numbers against the
# blocks of ../jqa/code_table.tsv. Each block keeps its inner order: Morris 100*i + r (r = 1..100) = JQA 100*(15 - i) + r.
# This file is read by decode.py; change a row here and the decode follows.
# basis: how the row is supported on frame 0039 (python decode.py --controls, sections B and C):
#   fw+bg = the claimed JQA block is the best block for this Morris block on function words alone, and first (or tied
#           first) on word bigrams from Ford, Writings of J. Q. Adams vols 3-4;
#   bg    = function words alone prefer another block; the claimed block is first (or tied first) on bigrams
#           (701-800 and 1201-1300 rest on only 2 bigrams each, 701-800 tied with one other block);
#   pattern+context = second on bigrams; kept because the reversal holds for every other block and the words read in
# The words column gives a few values from the table that read in context on frame 0039 (groups as Morris writes
# them; 1357 is "soon" in the table and the syllable son in Jefferson, reason, Madison).
